import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Fraction {
        long a, b;
        Fraction(long a, long b) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
        }
    }

    static Pair<Long, Long> geta(int x, int y, int b) {
        long lower = (long) b * x / y;
        long upper = ((long) b * x + y - 1) / y;
        return new Pair<>(lower, upper);
    }

    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        if (b == 0) return a;
        return gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    static void solve(int x, int y, int n, PrintWriter out) {
        List<Fraction> cands = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
            Pair<Long, Long> ap = geta(x, y, b);
            cands.add(new Fraction(ap.getKey(), b));
            cands.add(new Fraction(ap.getValue(), b));
        }

        cands.sort((fa, fb) -> {
            long a1 = fa.a;
            long b1 = fa.b;
            long a2 = fb.a;
            long b2 = fb.b;

            long left = Math.abs((long) x * b1 * b2 - a1 * b2 * y);
            long right = Math.abs((long) x * b1 * b2 - a2 * b1 * y);

            if (left < right) return -1;
            else if (left > right) return 1;

            if (b1 < b2) return -1;
            else if (b1 > b2) return 1;

            if (a1 < a2) return -1;
            return 1;
        });

        out.println(cands.get(0).a + "/" + cands.get(0).b);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        solve(x, y, n, out);
        out.flush();
        sc.close();
    }
}
